data.title: Supplications for when you wake up (1 of 4)

collections.name: Supplications for when you wake up

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
blocks.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā, wa ilayhi an-nushūr
blocks.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

references.citation: البخاري مع الفتح، 11/ 113، برقم 6314، ومسلم، 4/ 2083، برقم 2711.

data.gradingNote: Reference as printed in Hisn al-Muslim; grading pending review

collections.name: What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

blocks.arabic: يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ

data.title: The reward for visiting the sick

collections.name: The reward for visiting the sick

blocks.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
blocks.english: Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say:

blocks.arabic: إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ
blocks.english: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.

references.citation: رواه الترمذي، برقم 969، وابن ماجه، برقم 1442، وأحمد، برقم 975، وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه، 1/244 وصحيح الترمذي، 1/286، وصححه أيضاً أحمد شاكر.

data.gradingNote: Reference as printed in Hisn al-Muslim; grading pending review

data.title: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer (5 of 6)

collections.name: Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

blocks.transliteration: Wa subḥāna llāhi bukratan wa aṣīlā
blocks.english: I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon.

blocks.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَهَمْزِهِ
blocks.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni: min nafkhihi, wa nafthihi, wa hamzih
blocks.english: I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.

references.citation: أخرجه أبو داود، 1/ 203، برقم 764، وابن ماجه، 1/ 265، برقم، 807، وأحمد، 4/ 85، برقم 16739، وقال شعيب الأرناؤوط في تحقيقه لمسند: ((حسن لغيره))، وقال عبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تخريجه للكلم الطيب لابن تيمية، برقم 78: ((وهو حديث صحيح بشواهده))، وذكره الألباني في صحيح الكلم الطيب، برقم 62، وأخرجه مسلم عن ابن عمر ^ بنحوه، وفيه قصة، 1/ 420، برقم 601.

entryNumber.description: Entry locator within the source work.

chapterNumber.description: Chapter number in the source work, or null for an unnumbered collection.

entryPosition.description: This entry's one-based position in the collection.

entryTotal.description: Total entries in the collection for this release.

id.description: Stable position-based ID within this entry revision.

type.description: The role of this non-recited text.

arabic.description: Arabic wording, or null when the source gives none.

transliteration.description: Transliteration when relevant, otherwise null. Instructions normally use null.

english.description: English wording, or null when unavailable.

englishSource.description: Who prepared the English wording, or null when English is unavailable.

annotations.description: Editorial wording identified within this context block.

id.description: Stable position-based ID within this entry revision.

type.description: Marks words intended to be recited.

label.description: Variant or part name, or null when no label is needed.

arabicScript.description: Arabic writing style used by this block.

transliteration.description: Latin-script reading aid, or null when unavailable.

transliterationSource.description: Who prepared the transliteration, or null when none is published.

english.description: English meaning, or null when unavailable.

englishSource.description: Who prepared the English meaning, or null when none is published.

repetition.description: Positive recitation count and optional wording, or null when no single count applies.

annotations.description: Non-recited wording anchored to this block.

count.description: Number of times to recite this block.

instruction.description: Source wording that adds timing or alternatives to the number.

kind.description: Whether wording was removed from recitable text or identified within non-recited context.

blockId.description: Content block to which the note belongs.

codeUnitOffset.description: Position in the named language field, counted as UTF-16 code units. For removed non-recited wording, this is its insertion point.

objectKey.description: Immutable path under an audio origin. It is never an absolute URL.

covers.description: Recitation blocks heard in this recording, in playback order.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the citation text.

PublicEntry.title: OpenDua public entry v2
PublicEntry.description: One source-traceable OpenDua entry. The ordered blocks array is the only authority for text and reading order. Recordings identify the recitation blocks they cover.

id.description: Stable OpenDua identifier. It is never reused and is not limited to three digits.

slug.description: Stable URL-friendly name for the entry.

form.description: Whether the entry contains a supplication, Quran passage, action to perform, or hadith report.

source.description: The primary work and numbered entry from which this record was prepared.

collections.description: Chapters or other browsing collections containing this entry. Positions are one-based.

blocks.description: Authoritative text in display order. Clients must not reconstruct text from titles or references.

recordings.description: Playable recordings in order. An empty list means that no recording is available or required.

references.description: Additional source notes and citations, in source order.

hadithGrades.description: Published hadith assessments. An empty list means that no assessment is published.

gradingNote.description: Why no settled hadith assessment is published, or null when no explanation is needed.

tags.description: Stable topic and source labels used for filtering.

reviews.description: Named source, translation, scholar, and audio review states. Staging does not imply scholarly approval.

revision.description: Entry-level revision, increased when displayed or recited content changes.

rightsProfile.description: Identifier in the rights registry for this entry's text, metadata, and recordings.

textHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical compact JSON for blocks only.

mediaHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical compact JSON for recordings only.

recordHash.description: SHA-256 of the complete canonical entry before textHash, mediaHash, and recordHash are added.

RightsRegistry.title: OpenDua rights registry v2
RightsRegistry.description: Reusable rights statements and the entry profiles that select them.

NotFound.description: Requested entry, collection or version does not exist

IncompatibleVersion.description: The requested data release belongs to another API schema version
